svg.title: 06 place programmable block
svg.desc: Editable native text and vector geometry, transparent background. No embedded raster artwork.

text.data-source-text: Place a programmable block on the same construct as the arm. This block will run AutoArm. The example keeps it beside the arm on a connected foundation grid.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Place a programmable block on the same construct as the arm. This bloc
text.tspan: the same construct as the arm.

svg.title: Classical arm pose with programmable block — isometric view
svg.desc: The same complete arm with a raised shoulder, bent elbow, returning forearm and downward-facing drill, with a control seat and programmable block on the connected foundation grid.
